heading: Targets
body: The bundle targets are web, macos, windows, linux, ios and android. The web target writes browser assets. Every other target prepares a host that contains the platform WebView. Native packaging needs the SDKs (software development kits) and host tools for that platform. The windows target also needs the WebView2 SDK: restore the `Microsoft.Web.WebView2` package and set `TAC_WEBVIEW2_SDK` to the folder where you extracted it, or the build stops with `TY1605`. The all target builds every target. It writes one folder for each target under dist/. You must still test on each platform.
